sources.reason: The archive transaction currently rewrites documentationAlignment and changedFiles but not acceptanceEvidence.
The committed aggregate PR validator correctly rejects evidence paths that no longer exist.

riskAssessment.reason: Changing archive-time evidence rewriting can corrupt immutable evidence or hide a genuinely missing path unless replacements are exact, structure-aware, and rollback-tested.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized fixing discovered process defects before resuming the blocked Work Item and requested continuous execution.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm exact path-valued evidence is migrated while command and execution provenance strings remain immutable.
Confirm the archive Manifest digest is calculated after Summary migration.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A1: Archive rewrites every exact path-valued reference to the current active Contract, Summary, review, success, or outcome file within mutable Summary evidence structures to its generated archive path before hashing and manifest generation.

A2: acceptanceEvidence, documentationAlignment, changedFiles, scenario evidence, sourcesUsed, generatedFiles, user-correction solidifiedIn/location, nested collections, and future schema-conforming path/evidence fields use one structural migration mechanism rather than a top-level field denylist.
A3: The complete verification subtree, ordinary prose, embedded or similar strings, unrelated paths, and non-string values remain unchanged.

A4: If migration or any later archive step fails, active evidence, archive index, generated status bytes, registered traceability, and partial archive artifacts are restored by the existing transaction rollback.

A5: Red-first regression coverage reproduces WI-10's stale acceptanceEvidence failure and submits the generated archive pair to aggregate PR validation, proving both success and unchanged genuinely missing-path rejection.
A6: The user instruction, plan, implementation, tests, verification, archive, PR, Hosted CI, merge, closure, and branch cleanup remain bidirectionally traceable.

A7: The low-risk Bandit baseline is deliberately rebound from 114 to 112 findings because removal of the best-effort subprocess rollback also removes one B603 finding and one silent-exception B110 finding; no medium or high severity finding is introduced.
guidelines: Use exact repository-relative replacement only for schema-defined path values and evidence/path collections, never prose or substring replacement.
Keep the complete verification subtree, including future execution provenance fields, unchanged.
Make Summary migration part of the existing atomic archive transaction before digest and Manifest generation.
Add a regression for every newly covered Summary structure and a negative case for unrelated/missing evidence.
Record the discovered defect and durable process correction in the remediation plan and traceability map.

intent.problem: WI-10 completed all local checks and ai-finish, but committed check-ai-pr failed because three acceptanceEvidence entries still referenced the active Summary path after that Summary had been moved into archive. The archive implementation already knows every active-to-archive replacement, yet applies them only to documentationAlignment and changedFiles. This field-specific rewrite leaves any other Summary evidence structure vulnerable to the same recurring omission.
constraints: Do not edit WI-10's immutable archive bundle in place.
Do not weaken check-ai-pr or accept missing evidence paths.
Preserve verification commands and execution provenance exactly.
Deliver this process correction as one independent Work Item and PR before resuming WI-10.
intent.rationale: The archive transaction is the only component that knows the complete active-to-archive identity map and controls Summary hashing, Manifest creation, index update, and rollback. Applying one structure-aware exact-path migration there eliminates memory-dependent field lists and prevents future Summary schema additions from recreating the defect.
